warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 3.00 (6.00); y = A-B-C-D at 3.50 + 3.50 + 2.00 (9.00). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, both S-02 views, S-03, A-07 (both sections) and A-08. The PDF carries a text layer for marks/labels but the dimension figures are vector strokes — every dimension value was read off the rendered page (zoomed crops).

Right-hand overhang beyond grid 3 is printed twice with different values: S-02 (second-floor structure) prints 0.50 and A-07 (รูปตัด A) prints 0.60. Kept both as separate lines (3' = 6.50, 3'' = 6.60; 0.10 apart, so not the same tick printed twice). The cantilever beams B3 on rows A and B follow the structural sheet (3', 0.50) by op01 precedence (structural plan beats architectural section); the 0.60 is most likely to the outside of the finish/railing, not the beam line.

Roof-frame ticks (S-03): 1.00 eave overhangs left of 1 and right of 3 (1' = -1.00, 3''' = 7.00), 1.00 gable overhangs above A and below D (A' = -1.00, D' = 10.00), the 1.75 rafter-line ticks (A'' = 1.75, B' = 5.25) and the 1.00 split of C-D (C'' = 8.00).

S-02 second floor prints 2.30 + 1.20 between A and B (A''' = 2.30, the B1 beam between S1 and PS) and 1.50 + 1.50 between 2 and 3 (2' = 4.50, the B3 beam); both S-02 views print 1.20 + 0.80 between C and D (C''' = 8.20, end of the ground-floor B1 cantilever on grid 1). A-07 รูปตัด B repeats 0.80 + 1.20 (C''' again) and รูปตัด A repeats 1.50 + 1.50 (2' again).

A-08 (stair ST-01 detail, extracted as a section) prints its plan and section chains against grids 1, 2 and C: x 1.100 + 0.600 + 1.300 = 3.000 (1'' = 1.10, 1''' = 1.70 — the two flights and the landing) and y 0.100 + 1.100 = 1.200 below C (C' = 7.10 stair edge, C''' = 8.20 again).

Not made into lines (member-internal, section 4 rule 4 'not an axis tick'): the S-04 truss panel chains (T1 1.000 x6, T2 1.000 x3 + 0.750 x4, T3 0.750 x4, T4 0.875 x8, T5 0.667 x3) — the truss elevations print no grid markers, so they stay on the truss elements; footing cap/pile spacings (S-06/S-07); beam/slab/column section sizes (S-08); the stair riser/tread chain (A-08).

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนน (A-07; A-01 notes: ระดับ ± 0.00 เป็นระดับถนนภายในโครงการ). Beam-top levels +0.10 (ground floor) and +2.75 (second floor) come from the S-02 beam tags 'B1(+0.10)' / 'B1(+2.75)' (legend BX (+X.XX) = แจ้งระดับหลังคาน) — no standalone label, so id null. ระดับดินเดิม (S-06/S-07 footing details) and ระดับฝ้าเพดาน (A-07) print no value: kept with level_m null; the 1.00 depth from ระดับดินเดิม to the cap top stays on the footing elements.

S-04 prints the T4 depth chain 0.750 + 0.711 = 1.461 down from ระดับอกไก่ +7.26 and the T5 depth 0.761 down from ระดับอกไก่ +6.56. Their unlabelled ticks became dummy levels with ASSIGNED ids (z+6.51, z+5.799 — no label is printed for them). Both chains land on 5.799, consistent with each other. 6.51 sits 0.05 from ระดับอกไก่ +6.56 and 5.799 sits 0.051 from ระดับหลังคา +5.85 (A-07) / หลังอะเส +5.85 (S-03/S-04): kept apart, as printed (section 4 rule 4: within 0.05 m keep both and say so).

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-04, S-06..S-08 plus A-07 (building sections, for levels) and A-08 (stair detail). The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-02..A-06, A-09, A-10, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-05 is listed in the A-01 index but is not in the downloaded set (siamplan web PDF skips it).
